title: Freeze the private API and remote data contract
acceptance_criteria: The contract documents POST /v1/pair, authenticated PUT push, authenticated PUT schedule, authenticated GET status, and authenticated DELETE revoke routes.
Request and response shapes, validation errors, 401/403 behavior, exact CORS origin policy, and token lifecycle are specified.
The remote schedule projection contains only enabled state, local time, timezone, and weekday mask; it contains no exercises, routines, or workout details.
The contract states that Step 4 delivery, retries, and Cron sending are out of scope for this feature.
completion_summary: Documented private pairing, authenticated push/schedule/status/revoke API, validation, CORS, token lifecycle, local-only boundary, and Step 4 scope.
